content.short: Chainlens is a modern, user-friendly EVM blockchain explorer with customizable branding, powerful search, sleek dashboards, and a complete API.
content.description: Chainlens is an intuitive EVM blockchain explorer designed for developers, operators, and end users. It offers customizable branding, a fast and powerful search, and sleek dashboards, along with a complete API for integrations and strong support for NFTs and tokens. Chainlens provides high-quality decoded blockchain data and insights for network operators, developers, and end users. Its hosted services make it quick and cost-effective to spin up a dedicated explorer, backed by a responsive, experienced team.
content.meta: Chainlens is a modern, user-friendly, and fast blockchain explorer for EVM networks. Discover Chainlens and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
